titulo: Your smoke alarm has an expiration date.
receta: regla con numero + pregunta de numero; pilar home safety, invierno
destinatario: se lo manda alguien que acaba de revisar su alarma a un familiar que nunca miro la fecha
regla_guardable: Smoke alarm: test it monthly, replace it 10 years after the date printed on the back.

interaccion.guardar: Test monthly. Replace 10 years after the manufacture date on the back.
interaccion.comentar: How old is your smoke alarm? Give me a number.

fuentes: NFPA (National Fire Protection Association), smoke alarm safety: test alarms monthly; replace smoke alarms at least every 10 years from the date of manufacture printed on the alarm (not the purchase date).
USFA/FEMA and CPSC smoke alarm guidance (same 10-year and monthly-test rules).

frases.texto: The smoke alarm on your ceiling might be expired.
frases.estilo: Dry and punchy, with a half smile.

frases.texto: The National Fire Protection Association says to replace smoke alarms at least every ten years.
And the ten years start on the date printed on the back, not the day you bought it.
So check the back of yours.
Also, press the test button once a month.
Heads up: a chirp usually means the battery is low, so swap it. If it keeps chirping, or it's a sealed ten-year alarm, replace the whole alarm.
Save this: test it monthly, and replace it ten years after the date on the back.
How old is your smoke alarm? Give me a number.
Send this to the friend who has never checked the date on their alarm.
